name: js-formatter
description: Second stack, small surface. Exercises router selection (frontend playbook over api-endpoint), reuse of existing helpers, and exact-output assertions.

commands: cd frontend && node -e "import('./src/format.mjs').then(m => { const s = m.formatAccountSummary({id:'acc-1001',name:'Northwind Trading',currency:'EUR',balance:1250050}); if (s !== 'Northwind Trading (#1001) — 12500,50 EUR') { console.error('got: ' + s); process.exit(1); } })"
